source: FraudShield AI Synthetic Digital Payments Engine (v1.0)
description: Simulated multi-channel digital payment (UPI / Card / NetBanking) transaction dataset reflecting real-world fraud indicators, velocity spikes, and credential anomalies.

features.amount: Transaction amount in fiat currency (INR/USD equivalent)
features.transaction_hour: Hour of the day when transaction was initiated (0 - 23)
features.transaction_frequency_24h: Number of transactions completed by the user in the past 24 hours
features.failed_attempts_24h: Number of incorrect PIN/password/OTP attempts in the past 24 hours
features.is_new_device: Binary indicator (1 if device footprint is novel, 0 if recognized)
features.is_new_beneficiary: Binary indicator (1 if recipient VPA/account is newly added)
features.amount_deviation_score: Ratio of current transaction amount to historical 30-day average spending (1.0 = normal)
features.location_risk_score: Heuristic IP/geo-anomaly score from 0.0 (safe home zone) to 1.0 (distant high-risk IP)

limitations: Synthetic transaction distribution modeled on retail digital payment patterns.
Demonstration purposes only; does not contain real PII or live banking data.
Ground truth labels reflect simulated fraud rules combined with probabilistic noise.
